title: Reconcile stale Staging runtime state from exact live certification

phases.objective: Allow a successful exact-runtime Staging certification to repair stale local runtime bookkeeping without weakening exact-commit fail-closed behavior or widening any mutation authority.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Auto-Deploy-Staging.ps1 re-certification of an already deployed exact main commit
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: When live certification proves the running app commit and branch exactly match the requested authority, the certification state rewrites stale commit/ref bookkeeping to that observed authority and Auto Deploy finalization can close ready; mismatched runtime identity still fails closed before reconciliation.
steps: Run re-certification against the exact eligible main SHA after the local runtime is healthy.
Normalize and compare observed.commit_sha to ExpectedCommit and observed.branch to Ref before changing runtime state.
Fail closed on either identity mismatch.
Only after exact identity proof, set state.commit and state.ref from the observed certified runtime and record the reconciliation source.
Persist certification status, exact certified commit, artifact image/tree/context bindings and database readiness.
Let Auto Deploy read back the reconciled state and finalize the same exact commit without redeploy or rebuild.
assertions: A stale historical state.commit cannot override a newly proven exact certified runtime.
Certification cannot rewrite state.commit when observed.commit_sha differs from ExpectedCommit.
Certification cannot rewrite state.ref when observed.branch differs from Ref.
The repaired state records live_certification_observed_runtime as commit authority.
No database, migration, provider, DNS, ruleset, Hostinger, or Production mutation is introduced.
No secret material is persisted or returned.

phases.objective: Preserve Production isolation; this repair does not authorize or execute Production deployment.
blockers: Production remains governed by its independent promotion and runtime certification lifecycle.
